name: tests-75pct-mcp-grafana-reviewable-sql-request-plans
instr:
mcp-grafana cannot expose SQL or metadata requests before datasource activity. Let MCP sessions approve and execute exact Grafana requests. Plans are session-bound, tamper-evident, and single-use; direct SQL retains processed requests, outputs, defaults, validation failures, and empty-result hints.

Resolve macros, variables, limits, datasource defaults, formats, and extra payload fields without execution. Prepare database, table, and column discovery as inspectable SQL or resource requests. Preserve Athena catalog, database, region, result reuse, and metadata resources; ClickHouse system-table queries, macro syntax, validated database filters, and LIMIT; MSSQL TOP, qualified information schemas, dbo defaults, and time expressions; MySQL formatting, information-schema exclusions, time substitutions, and LIMIT exemptions; both PostgreSQL datasource identifiers, timestamp casts, public defaults, and catalog exclusions; Snowflake timestamp conversion, database qualification, PUBLIC defaults, row counts, and byte projections.

`FingerprintSQLRequestPlan` and `DialectFor` from `github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana/tools/sql`, with `Dialect.PlanQuery` and `Dialect.PlanMetadata`, produce fingerprints solely from canonical executable plans. `PrepareSQL` from `github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana/tools` returns the inspectable plan, identifier, and fingerprint, storing nothing for invalid identifiers or unsupported datasources. `SQLPlanStore`, `NewSQLPlanStore`, `SQLPlanStore.Put`, `SQLPlanStore.
